description: An experience where a 3D character locks on and reacts: computer vision, real-time, and stable behaviour.

sections.title: The experience
sections.content:
The goal was to make the character feel present: it follows the viewer with believable reactions, without noticeable latency.

  • Real-time face/presence tracking.
  • Reactions + audio (lip-sync when needed).
  • Stable behaviour, even in imperfect conditions.

sections.title: What I built
sections.content:
• Vision pipeline: YOLO to detect/lock, with guardrails (tracking loss, false positives).
  • Unity for rendering, eye focus and animation, tuned to stay smooth.
  • Python + integrations to orchestrate audio and keep sync clean.
